data.name: AlAmal
data.gender_notes: AlAmal is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is expected or hoped for. A symbol of optimism and positivity. The name AlAmal carries the meaning “Hope, Expectation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose AlAmal usually hope their child will grow to embody hope, expectation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the blessings of Allah and the importance of maintaining faith and hope in His divine plan.
data.etymology: AlAmal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Hope, Expectation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlAmal total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: الأمل
in_arabic.meaning: الأمل هو طموح القلب و رجاءه في الخير
in_arabic.long_meaning: الأمل هو الطموح الذي يملأ قلب الإنسان بالتفاؤل و الرجاء في الخير، و هو شعور يبعث على الثقة و الإيمان بأن الغد أفضل، و في القرآن الكريم يقول الله تعالى: "وليأخذوا أسبابهم إلى الجنة"، و الأمل يعتبر من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الإيمان و الثقة بالله

in_urdu.name: الامل
in_urdu.meaning: الامل کا مطلب ہے دل کی آرزو اور اچھائی کی امید
in_urdu.long_meaning: الامل کا نام دل کی گہری ترین آرزؤں اور امیدوں سے جڑا ہوا ہے، جو انسان کو اچھائی اور مثبتیت کی جانب لے جاتا ہے، اور اسلامی روایات میں اس کا تعلق روحانی امید و توکل سے ہے

in_hindi.name: आलमल
in_hindi.meaning: आलमल का अर्थ है दिल की इच्छा और अच्छे की आशा
in_hindi.long_meaning: आलमल नाम दिल की गहरी इच्छाओं और अच्छे की आशा से जुड़ा है, जो व्यक्ति को सकारात्मकता और ईश्वर पर भरोसे की ओर ले जाता है, और भारतीय मुस्लिम परंपरा में इसका महत्व आध्यात्मिक आशा और सौभाग्य से जुड़ा है

in_pashto.name: الامل
in_pashto.meaning: الامل دى معنا د زړه هيله او د ښه والى هیله
in_pashto.long_meaning: الامل نوم د زړه له ژورو هيلو او د ښه والى له هيلو سره تړلی دی، کوم چې انسان د مثبت والى او پر الله باندې د باور په لور رهبري کوي، او په افغان او پښتون دود کې د روحاني هيلې او توکل سره تړاو لري

in_english.name: AlAmal
in_english.meaning: Hope, Aspiration, and Wish for Good
in_english.long_meaning: AlAmal originates from Arabic roots 'A-M-L' which signify hope, aspiration, and wish. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the spiritual hope and trust in Allah. The Quran mentions 'hope' as a vital component of faith. This name reflects optimism, faith in a better future, and is associated with positive personality traits such as resilience and determination. It is used across various Muslim cultures to signify good fortune and divine blessings.

data.cultural_impact: In Arabic culture, the name "AlAmal" symbolizes the idea of upward progress and positive EXPECTATIONS towards the future. It is also seen as a sign of encouragement and motivation for individuals to strive for their goals and dreams.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic context, the name "AlAmal" has a profound spiritual significance. It resonates with the believing heart's HOPES and FAITHS in the Divine Plan and the belief in a Predestined Future. It also serves as a reminder of Allah's infinite mercy and compassion towards us and the possibility of redemption and renewal. The name can be seen as an embodiment of the hadith: "And verily, with every hardship comes relief; and with every difficulty is a relief." (Prophet Muhammad SAW).
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Hope, Expectation" symbolizes One who is expected or hoped for. A symbol of optimism and positivity.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name AlAmal serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of hope, expectation.
